text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Misogi! It's too dangerous to charge in like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギ！　
そんなに突っ込んだら危ないよ！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
B-but...!
I can't use my bombs when it's always attacking,
so I've gotta get in closer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも
こんな攻撃の中じゃ爆弾も使えないし、
近づいて攻撃するしかないじゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: That's true, but... At this rate, it'll get you before you—
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだけど……
でもこのままじゃ
近づく前にミソギが――！
